env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A direct alias for a pointer to a hidden decoder type is rejected: the
# holder cannot name the element the trial would allocate, so validation
# and the generated decoder agree on a diagnostic instead of emitting
# code that cannot build.
cd bad
! logos run .
stderr 'points to an unexported type'

-- bad/go.mod --
module example.com/unionaliasdirecthidden

go 1.27
-- bad/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
)

type hidden struct {
	X int64 `json:"x"`
}

func (h *hidden) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error {
	var m map[string]int64
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &m); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	v, ok := m["x"]
	if !ok {
		return errors.New("hidden requires x")
	}
	h.X = v
	return nil
}

type Ptr = *hidden
-- bad/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"

	"example.com/unionaliasdirecthidden/lib"
)

type Other struct {
	Y string `json:"y"`
}

func (o *Other) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error {
	var m map[string]string
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &m); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	v, ok := m["y"]
	if !ok {
		return errors.New("Other requires y")
	}
	o.Y = v
	return nil
}

type U interface {
	lib.Ptr | *Other
}

type H struct {
	Item U `json:"item"`
}

func main() {
	var h H
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"item":{"x":31}}`), &h); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("decode err:", err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Printf("decoded %T\n", h.Item)
}
